name: QRIO
summary: A knee-high entertainment humanoid developed by Sony as a follow-on to the AIBO robot dog. In 2003 QRIO was demonstrated running — briefly having both feet off the ground at once — the first self-contained humanoid to do so, eighteen years after MIT's boom-mounted Planar Biped first ran on two legs. It could also recover from pushes, dance in coordinated groups and recognize faces and voices. Sony canceled the program in 2006 without selling it.
notable: First self-contained humanoid robot to run (2003) — the legs-only MIT Planar Biped had been running since 1985
Push recovery and coordinated group dancing at knee height
